Machine-readable: `docs/bid/package/compliance_matrix_v1.json`.

Clause text is the repository's verbatim transcription (`docs/requirements/rfp_official/rfp_registration_v1.json`, 37 clauses, pages 16-21, 27, 30). Every evidence path below is a file at `b0937e8`; read it with `git show b0937e8:<path>`. Locators are JSON pointers (with `[key=value]` list selection) or section names.

Statuses never claim more than the evidence shows. At `b0937e8` no RVM row of the flight configuration is PASS (27 NOT_EVALUATED, 3 INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE), the Hall credible transport set is empty and every absolute 0-D Hall result is withdrawn; this matrix quotes none of them.

## Status vocabulary

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| COMPLY | the offered design, as recorded at the technical source b0937e8, already meets the clause as written (a property of the offer; no test result is implied) |
| COMPLY_PLANNED_WITH_EVIDENCE_PATH | Vyovrinda proposes to comply; the repository at b0937e8 holds the plan / verification path (file + locator); nothing is yet demonstrated |
| PARTIAL | some sub-items have a plan or evidence path at b0937e8, others have none yet (listed in the response) |
| NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED | a technical performance requirement whose outcome depends on hardware / validation evidence that does not exist at b0937e8; the programme has a path, but the package must not claim the outcome |
| OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED | the response depends on organisational, commercial or design-authority information that the repository does not hold; the owner must supply it |

## Clause responses

### RFP-P16-01 (p. 16, Part III 1(A)i) - COMPLY_PLANNED_WITH_EVIDENCE_PATH

> RFP (verbatim transcription): 1. Development of Air Breathing Electric Propulsion (ABEP) which will work in the VLEO environment. 2. Testing and space qualification of the Air Breathing Electric Propulsion (ABEP).

**Response.** Vyovrinda proposes to develop, test and space-qualify an ABEP system for VLEO. The programme is hardware-first (owner pivot 2026-09-27, A9.21 hardware order); the development and test plan (03_DEVELOPMENT_AND_TEST_PLAN.md) maps it onto Milestones 1-5. No part of the system is yet demonstrated: at b0937e8 all 30 RVM rows of the flight configuration are NOT_EVALUATED (27) or INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (3); none is PASS.

**Evidence at b0937e8:**

### RFP-P16-02 (p. 16, Part III 1(A)ii Figure 1) - COMPLY_PLANNED_WITH_EVIDENCE_PATH

> RFP (verbatim transcription): Logical Block Diagram: Intake -> Filter -> Compressor -> Gas Chamber -> Valve -> Thruster (Ionization zone | Acceleration zone) -> Thrust; Xenon Gas -> Valve -> Thruster.

**Response.** The proposed architecture follows the RFP logical block diagram: Intake (F1) -> Filter (F2) -> Compressor (F3) -> Gas Chamber / plenum (F4) -> Valve (atmospheric metering / isolation valve) -> Thruster (H-1 Hall accelerator: ionization zone and acceleration zone in one channel) -> Thrust; Xenon Gas -> Valve -> Thruster (separate Xe storage / flow path, AL-08: two series latch isolation valves + one proportional flow-control valve). One element is ADDED outside the diagram: a downstream 13.56 MHz RF-ICP electron source / neutralizer (owner decisions A9, A9.19); the flight architecture hall_icp_neutralizer is cathodeless (flight cathode NONE; supply modes AIR_PRIMARY + XE_CONTINGENCY). Status INVESTIGATION_HYPOTHESIS: topology decided and frozen for development, physical design not frozen. The upstream chain exists as design-synthesis screening over the frozen 196-state design-state set; its robust upstream set is EMPTY (F9-DF-01 EMPTY_ROBUST_SET_NOT_EVALUATED).

### RFP-P17-02 (p. 17, Part III 1(A)iii) - NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED

> RFP (verbatim transcription): List of critical technologies required for the solution: 1. Electric propulsion thruster to Ionize and accelerate N2 and nascent O. 2. Material compatibility to with stand VLEO atmospheric nascent oxygen. 3. Air Intake system design and compressor technology. 4. Test facility to simulate air mixture conditions in VLEO environment.

**Response.** Each listed critical technology is addressed, none is yet demonstrated: (1) thruster ionizing N2 and nascent O: Hall transport validation gate 3 is FAIL at b0937e8 (credible transport set empty; P5-N2 v1 INCONCLUSIVE, permanent), the N2/N reaction set is complete only for its pre-registered domain, and the O/O2 chemistry v0 tables are DRAFT and unused; (2) AO material compatibility: AO / lifetime register v5 and the P4 anode-materials framework exist, every P4 gate is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE, anode material OPEN; RVM-16 is read for the current architecture (OWNER_CONFIRMED_CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE_READING: no flight keeper; AO / O compatibility applies to the actual AO / O-exposed components - anode, RF-ICP electron-source / neutralizer plasma-facing surfaces, collector / bias electrode, gas path; no graphite as the current flight baseline for O / AO-exposed plasma-facing or electron-source surfaces until coupon evidence supports it); (3) intake and compressor: F1-F4 parametric screening over the frozen 196-state design-state set, robust upstream set EMPTY (F9-DF-01); (4) test facility simulating the VLEO air mixture: no facility record exists in the repository (OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED, see 05_PROGRAMMATIC_SECTIONS.md).

### RFP-P17-03 (p. 17, Part III 1(A)iv row 1 Air Intake) - NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED

> RFP (verbatim transcription): Air intake system captures residual atmospheric particles (mainly atomic oxygen and nitrogen) at VLEO altitudes (< 250 km). Most challenging in total system.

**Response.** Intake design is the subject of design-synthesis lane F1 (TPMC reduced-order intake model, Maxwell + CLL wall models, frozen NRLMSIS 2.1 atmosphere, frozen 196-state design-state set atmosphere_msis21_orbit_v1_design_states_v2, BROAD_ENVELOPE_ALL_INCLINATIONS_ALL_LTAN_NOT_MISSION_ICD). At b0937e8 the coupled upstream screen is model-derived under PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY inputs: the nominal all-state delivered-flow frontier is 0.01296 mg/s, 0 Pareto members reach the lower end (0.38 mg/s) of the ground characterization coverage at every state (F78-02; coverage, not a requirement), and the F8 robust upstream set is EMPTY (0 members; F9-DF-01 EMPTY_ROBUST_SET_NOT_EVALUATED). This is a design finding for the owner, not a demonstrated requirement failure and not a requirement relaxation; no robust upstream (intake / compressor / feed) closure is claimed.

### RFP-P17-05 (p. 17, Part III 1(A)iv row 3 Thruster) - NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED

> RFP (verbatim transcription): Capability to ionize N2, atomic oxygen in same thruster and It should have capability to use Xe as propellant, an extra input system to take care any problems on board unforeseen problems.

**Response.** One H-1 Hall accelerator is proposed for atmospheric N2 / O-bearing propellant and Xe, with one downstream RF-ICP neutralizer serving both supply modes (A9.19; no conventional hollow cathode in flight). Xe capability is retained as the RFP's 'extra input system' (XE_CONTINGENCY / emergency supply mode; DISC-06 recorded). Not demonstrated: no Hall transport closure is admitted (gate 3 FAIL), O2-bearing ground tests are labelled NO_ATOMIC_O (atomic O only through the separate AO programme), and the Xe operation of the ICP is not yet measured (ICP-XE-MODE campaign planned).

### RFP-P18-01 (p. 18, Part III 1(A)iv row 4 Power System Electronics) - COMPLY_PLANNED_WITH_EVIDENCE_PATH

> RFP (verbatim transcription): Power system electronics shall capable taking power from satellite bus and provide the total ABEP system required voltages and Current requirements.

**Response.** A propulsion PPU taking power from the satellite bus and generating all ABEP supplies (Hall discharge, per-coil magnet supplies, 13.56 MHz RF generator + matching, ICP collector / bias, valve drivers, compressor drive, thermal control, housekeeping) is proposed; there are no flight cathode heater / keeper supplies (flight cathode NONE). The bus-power boundary (A9-02, v2 for the single flight configuration) and preliminary PPU options (H2-4: LCC resonant or ZVS full-bridge discharge supply analogs) exist as PRELIMINARY_DRAFT_FOR_OWNER; the spacecraft-side input voltage is TBD (A902-12) and every load value is TBD. No PPU hardware exists.

### RFP-P18-11 (p. 18, Part III 2 Mass) - NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED

> RFP (verbatim transcription): < 40kg

**Response.** Requirement: complete flight wet mass < 40 kg (the owner's conservative wet reading of the RFP '< 40kg'; DISC-02 recorded for DRDO clarification); not relaxed. Proposal design target (owner decision A9.26): nominal dry <= 34.0 kg with a 10 % system margin and the 2 kg Xe planning reference -> 39.4 kg wet - a DESIGN TARGET, not evidence; the 2 kg Xe case is a planning reference, not the selected Xe load. Current provisional planning / evidence roll-up (mass_power_a9_v4 at b0937e8; owner allocations and MEV planning floors, no CBE, no measured mass): dry 40.57 kg after a 20 % system margin; wet 42.57 / 45.57 / 50.57 kg at the 2 / 5 / 10 kg Xe planning / sensitivity cases (DOES_NOT_CLOSE in all 3 cases against < 40 kg); AL-09 has no value in this record and is excluded from the known part. Current status: MASS INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE / NOT_YET_CLOSED (AG-11 INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (no CBE; AL-04 / AL-07 / AL-08 below evidence floors)); no mass compliance is claimed. Mass-closure actions: AL-07 current cathodeless PPU CBE / requote; AL-08 quote / design rebase; AL-04 completed Hall-head CBE; AL-09 design-derived CBE; actual routed harness; subsystem integration / structural optimization. Disclosed open item (risk R-07).
